correctness.rationale: For bidirected C_{n+1}, a face is a cyclic {+,−,0}-word with no adjacent opposite nonzero signs and excluding the two full directed cycles. A mixed-sign face needs >=2 gaps, hence has <=n-1 arcs and dimension <=n-2. Every top n-1-simplex is a pure-sign word missing one arc; the pure ± subcomplexes are two embedded ∂Δ^n spheres S^{n-1}. Their highest boundary supports are disjoint, so their fundamental classes form an integral basis for top H_{n-1}=Z². Caputi–Collari–Smith 2026 Theorems 2.8/2.10 give simply connectivity for n>=6 and complete lower free homology. For n≡0 mod4, vanishing H_{d-1} upgrades (d-2)-connectivity to (d-1)-connectivity by Hurewicz. Lower Hurewicz lifts and two geometric top sphere maps induce an integral homology equivalence from the stated sphere wedge; homology Whitehead for simply connected CW complexes yields homotopy equivalence. Independent face enumeration n=6,7,8 finds 476,1152,2784 faces, reduced Euler −1, and top facet counts 14,16,18; no finite check substitutes for n-uniform proof.
